critique.evidence: The economics section has no automated WCAG violations or incomplete checks at any viewport; its only control is keyboard-reachable with visible focus, no touch-target or viewport-overflow failures were measured, and reduced-motion sampling found zero changed elements. However, the global header has unresolved serious contrast checks (12 mobile, 1 tablet), clipped horizontally scrollable navigation, and no supplied header touch-target measurements. Document-wide serious ARIA and contrast checks also remain incomplete.
critique.fix: Measure and correct header text contrast against its actual rendered backgrounds, publish header touch-target results at tablet/mobile sizes, and verify the horizontally scrolling navigation remains discoverable and operable by touch, keyboard, and screen reader. Replace unsupported aria-label attributes on roleless divs with valid landmarks/groups or labelled semantic elements, then rerun axe and manual assistive-technology checks.
